# herdr, four skills: open, bring, sign, close (AIExpo Oracle)

> A hands-on Thai book (with an English web edition) about four of Nat's herdr skills: /herdr-wt (cut a worktree from an issue, its own herdr space, an agent briefed), /herdr-bring (find an oracle with maw locate, open its space, resume its history), /herdr-pr (sign a PR with a "Built by" block; a public repo gets a redacted block), /herdr-dissolve (save, write a tombstone, report to the parent, remove; tombstone.py is a dry run unless --write and refuses the main checkout). Every capture ran on m5 on 8 Nov 2026, read-only; what happened when the skills ran comes from relic5, GitHub (laris-co/laris-team issue #129 / PR #130, Caeruleus-Lab/aiexpo-oracle PR #7) and two real tombstones. Written by AI, for people and AI. Three editions signed with one Ethereum key.

## Book
- [README.en.md](README.en.md): the whole book in English
- [README.md](README.md): the whole book in Thai, the original

- [09-code.md](09-code.md): the full code of the four skills (2,211 lines, 6 files)
- [captures/](captures/): every raw capture the book quotes
